curve_slowdown_factor.description: Curve slowdown: 1 = vanilla; 0 = no curve speed cap; 0.5 = twice the curve limit; 2 = half. Signals and braking remain active.

acceleration_multiplier.description: Positive speed gain under engine traction per simulation tick. 1 = vanilla; 10 = ten times the acceleration. Braking and target-speed limits remain active.

wagon_capacity_multiplier.description: Cargo wagon capacity multiplier, combined with difficulty/research bonuses. Existing cargo is retained when capacity decreases.

speed_multiplier.description: Train top-speed and rail speed-limit multiplier. Available engine power still limits speed; station maneuvering limits and signals remain active.

loading_speed_multiplier.description: Loading cycle speed, including connection, crane/transfer animations and disconnect. 10 = ten times faster; 0.1 = ten times slower. Supply and space limits still apply.

unloading_speed_multiplier.description: Unloading cycle speed, including connection, crane/transfer animations, disconnect and molten-wagon tilt. 10 = ten times faster; 0.1 = ten times slower. Storage limits still apply.
